thread:
Maya Singh: Hey team — I uploaded a new draft for the Optimize launch post here: https://drive.redwood/optimize-v2-draft. Looking for quick checks on the benchmark language, a customer quote shortform, accessibility alt text for the hero, and the final CTA mapping. Target publish window Wed 9am PT. Can we get signoff by Tue EOD?

Noah Alvarez: reading now. flagged one numeric tweak: earlier we used "~35% cost reduction" across our internal traces, but I'd prefer we say "up to 35%" and add a parenthetical about workload mix. keeps it defensible.

Priya Rao: agree with Noah. Also, can we try two meta descriptions for SEO? one focused on "inference cost" and one on "batching and latency". Growth can pick a winner.

GrowthBot: suggested meta descriptions: 
- "Cut LLM inference costs with Redwood Optimize — smarter batching and cache-aware serving."
- "Lower per-token bills without sacrificing latency — see Redwood Optimize in action."
I'll run quick SERP keyword check and report back by EOD.

DesignKit: need specs: hero stills (1600x900) + social square (1200x1200) + hero GIF max 3s. Also require alt text for accessibility. Maya — can you provide the alt text line?

Maya Singh: alt text suggestion: \"Visualization: Redwood Optimize dashboard showing throughput gains and cost per token reductions\". open to edits. Also, we'd like to include a 1-sentence customer quote from Beta partner if legal approves anonymized phrasing.

LegalBot: please attach the perf logs and the anonymized quote draft. For the quote we need explicit consent in writing; if partner OK with anonymized line, provide email trail. For hero claim: approved with qualifier: \"based on internal benchmarks using customer-like workloads; results may vary.\"

Noah Alvarez: pasted a short methods blurb to include under Benchmarks: 
```
Methods: Benchmarks run on a mix of chat and retrieval traces (4 workloads). Models tested: redwood-7b-q, redwood-14b. Quantization: 4-bit with activation clipping. Results are medians over 3 runs per workload.
```
Linking perf artifacts in drive.

Avery Chen: inbound routing plan: blog CTAs -> HubSpot form id `opt_launch_2026`; utm params: `?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=optimize_launch_2026`. Webinar regs -> workflow tag `interest:optimize`. I'll create lead routing rule to SDR queue "Infra-PLG" for high-intent signals.

Maya Singh: thanks Avery. Can you also set hidden field `source_component=blog_cta` so we can trace registrations?

Avery Chen: yes, will add `source_component` and a hidden `region` field for geo routing. Posting sample mapping: 
```
hubspot.form.create(id='opt_launch_2026', hidden_fields={'source_component':'blog_cta','region':'auto'})
```

DesignKit: quick accessibility note — ensure color contrast on the chart lines meets AA. I'll post color swatches in the drive.

GrowthBot: headline A/B suggestions for test: 
A) "Redwood Optimize: Reduce Inference Cost Without Trading Latency"
B) "Batch Smarter, Serve Faster — Introducing Optimize"
I'll wire these into the A/B test in the CMS once headline locked.

Priya Rao: editorial ask — we need a ~30-word webinar blurb under CTA and an exact time. proposed blurb: \"Join our team Mar 15, 10am PT to see how Optimize reduces inference unit costs and preserves latency. Live demo + customer AMA. Register now.\" OK to use?

Noah Alvarez: fine. can we add "live demo + customer AMA" only if the customer confirmed? otherwise say "live demo + Q&A".

Maya Singh: pinged partner for quote and permission. will share email thread here.

LegalBot: received logs, approving hero phrasing with qualifier. waiting on partner consent for the quote. if no consent by Tue noon, drop quote and proceed.

DesignKit: uploaded hero + social assets with alt text and color notes. added a static fallback for the GIF for email clients.

Avery Chen: HubSpot form and UTMs created. routing rule set to "Infra-PLG" with tag `optimize_launch_2026`.

GrowthBot: keyword check: primary terms "inference cost", "LLM batching". recommends headline A for SEO.

Maya Singh: final check: Legal ok (with qualifier), Design assets complete, Growth recommends headline A, HubSpot mapped, methods + perf artifacts in drive. Any blockers?

Priya Rao: no blockers from product. locking publish Wed 9am PT. If partner quote arrives in time we'll slot in the short callout; if not, publish without. Marking this thread as final signoff. :white_check_mark:

Noah Alvarez: approved.

Avery Chen: approved.

DesignKit: approved.

LegalBot: approved (conditional on qualifier).

Maya Singh: thanks all — moving to publish checklist and scheduling a quick pre-publish smoke test Tue 5pm PT.
